stem_text: A closed circular tube of average radius 15 cm, whose inner walls are rough, is kept in vertical plane. A block of mass 1 kg just fits inside the tube. The speed of block is 22 m/s, when it is introduced at the top of tube. After completing five oscillations, the block stops at the bottom region of tube. The work done by the tube on the block is __________ J. (Given g = 10 m/s ^(2) ). [FIG-stem-1]

candidate_solve.derivation: Initial speed v0 = 22 m/s at top. Comes to rest at bottom region. Delta KE = 0 - (1/2)*m*v0^2 = -0.5 * 1 * 484 = -242 J. Work by gravity: drop h = 2*R = 2*0.15 = 0.3 m => W_g = m*g*h = 1 * 10 * 0.3 = 3 J. Work-energy theorem: W_net = W_g + W_tube = Delta KE => 3 + W_tube = -242 => W_tube = -245 J. Held on figure custody.
